fandom.name: Fandom
fandom.description: Shows a summary card with an image, key facts and a link when a search matches a page on one of the Fandom wikis you add, such as callofduty.fandom.com.

wikis.label: Wikis
wikis.description: Fandom wikis to search, in order of priority. Searches that pass a quick check are looked up on each wiki by your degoog server.

url.label: Wiki URL
url.description: Address of a wiki on fandom.com. Language wikis such as https://naruto.fandom.com/es work too.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional, comma separated. A search starting or ending with one, such as “cod ghost”, only looks on this wiki. The wiki’s subdomain always works.

bareMatch.label: Match page titles on their own
bareMatch.description: Show a card when the whole search is a page title, such as “simon riley”. Turn off to need a keyword, or “wiki” or “fandom” at the end.

showImage.label: Show image
showImage.description: Show the page’s main image. Images are loaded through degoog’s image proxy.

showFacts.label: Show facts
showFacts.description: List rows from the page’s infobox.

maxFacts.label: Number of facts
maxFacts.description: How many infobox rows to show, from 1 to 10.
